{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script> [build.sh args...]

# Slurm resources:
#   --job-name="glotzerlab-software build"
#   --account=dmr140129
#   --partition=shared
#   --ntasks=1
#   --cpus-per-task=32
#   --time=8:00:00

#flux: --job-name="glotzerlab-software build"
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 32
#flux: --time-limit=8h

# Omitted Slurm option: --account=dmr140129
# Flux accounting/project selection is site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted Slurm option: --partition=shared
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run on different hardware or with different limits/priority (or be rejected by policy).

export OUTPUT_FOLDER="$PROJECT/software/conda"
unset CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH

module reset
module load gcc/11.2.0 openmpi/4.1.6

export CC="$GCC_HOME/bin/gcc"
export CXX="$GCC_HOME/bin/g++"

./build.sh "$@" \
    --skip-existing \
    --variants "{'cluster': ['anvil'], 'device': ['cpu'], 'gpu_platform': ['none']}" \
    --output-folder "$OUTPUT_FOLDER"

chmod g-w "$OUTPUT_FOLDER" -R
"
}
